description: This file defines classes and functions for managing Chromium protocol connections, sessions, and debugging within the Playwright project. It includes classes like CRConnection, CRSession, and CDPSession, handling message passing, session management, and event handling for Chromium remote debugging.

classes.name: CRConnection
classes.description: Manages a connection to a Chromium remote debugging session, handling message routing, session management, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: CRSession
classes.description: Represents a session within a CRConnection, managing protocol commands, responses, and event handling for a specific target.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: A higher-level session class for interacting with a specific target via the Chrome DevTools Protocol, supporting event listening and target attachment.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message with a specific session ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, routing them to the appropriate session.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles the closing of the connection, cleaning up resources and emitting disconnect events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if it is not already closed.

methods.name: createBrowserSession
methods.description: Creates a new browser session by attaching to the browser target.

methods.name: createChildSession
methods.description: Creates a child session within a CRSession.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command within a CRSession.

methods.name: _sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a protocol command and logs errors if it fails.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the session from its target.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, cleaning up resources and rejecting pending callbacks.

methods.name: attachToTarget
methods.description: Attaches to a specific target and returns a new CDPSession.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles the closure of a CDP session.
